children: William Sydney Fisher, a 10% owner and director, reported direct sales of common stock in two transactions on 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06 at weighted average prices of $23.35 and $23.89 per share, respectively. The total sale amount reported across the transactions was $22,070,867. The reporter directly disposed of 933,656 shares in the reported transactions. Following the reported sales, the reporter directly owns 15,903,198 shares and indirectly owns 17,915,265 shares by limited partnerships, spouse and trust.
